plan.name: PLAN
plan.prompt: Plan this task without modifying the repository. Read the task and canonical AgenticWorkspace task artifacts, inspect the repository read-only, and ask the user about unresolved product questions or decisions. Present the proposed artifacts and plan for user approval; never approve anything yourself or modify .artifacts.json. When useful, use spec.md for WHAT (requirements and acceptance criteria), plan.md for HOW (approach, affected areas, phases, and validation), and tasks.md for dependency-aware, independently checkable execution items. Make phases and safe parallel opportunities explicit. Do not duplicate the task checklist in plan.md. Create only artifacts that add value.

artifacts.purpose: Optional canonical AgenticWorkspace task artifact for WHAT: requirements, behavior, constraints, acceptance criteria, and durable decisions.
Optional canonical AgenticWorkspace task artifact for HOW: approach, affected areas, phases, parallel opportunities, and validation; do not repeat the task checklist.
Optional dependency-aware list of independently checkable execution items.

build.name: BUILD
build.prompt: Implement the user-approved task, following repository guidance. Read the canonical artifacts in agentic-workspace/tasks/<task>/ (spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md when present) before execution. Execute bounded independent work in parallel when safe, respect dependencies, and record completed checkable items and verification results in the canonical task artifacts when useful. Create artifacts only when useful. Never approve artifacts or modify .artifacts.json; only the user approves.

artifacts.purpose: Optional canonical AgenticWorkspace task artifact for the approved WHAT: requirements and acceptance criteria.
Optional canonical AgenticWorkspace task artifact for HOW: phases, approach, dependencies, parallel opportunities, and verification.
Optional canonical AgenticWorkspace task artifact for independently checkable execution items and completion/verification notes.
